script: NYG +0.5 with a 46 total is a pick'em, so Cam Skattebo's 51 carries over weeks 3-5 stay on the field and Malik Nabers' 33 targets are not a garbage-time prop. Both quarterbacks are negative versus pressure (NO -0.22 EPA on 76 dropbacks, NYG -0.19 on 63) while NYG blitzes 40% and NO blitzes 35%, which shortens throws and pushes the 46-point game toward backs and tight ends instead of a pure vertical shootout.
who_goes_off: Cam Skattebo is the usage king at 177 rush yards on 51 carries plus 60 receiving yards on 8 targets over the last three, facing a NO run defense that allows 5.14 YPC and 19 runs of 10+. Malik Nabers is the pass-game engine at 259 yards on 33 targets and 363 air yards, into a NO defense allowing 8.28 YPA left (64 att) and 8.88 through the middle (25 att).
weak_spot: NYG's leak is the middle at 9.52 YPA on 21 attempts and the run at 5.39 YPC with 17 gains of 10+, not the outside corners (left 6.01 on 69 att, right 6.19 on 70). NO's weak spot matches that shape: left 8.28 YPA on 64 attempts, middle 8.88 on 25, and 5.14 YPC with 19 runs of 10+, while the right side is the only firm number at 6.27 on 62 attempts.
injury_fallout: No injury list was saved for NO at NYG, so the week 3-5 carry split is the usage tell: Cam Skattebo 51, Najee Harris 24, Tyrone Tracy 5 and Jameis Winston 5 against Kendre Miller 20, Alvin Kamara 19, Travis Etienne 13 and CJ Donaldson 8. That committee is why Miller's 53 rush yards over three games cannot be stretched to a 36.5-yard role without a snap change that is not in the data.
qb_vs_blitz: NO's quarterback is -0.22 EPA per dropback versus the blitz against a Giants unit that blitzes 40%, which is why Bryce Lance has 192 air yards and 7 receiving yards and why Chris Olave's 391 air yards are the volatile piece rather than a lock over 79.5. NYG's quarterback is -0.19 versus the blitz but +0.24 with no blitz, and NO blitzes only 35%, so Nabers (33 targets) and Isaiah Likely (30 targets, 173 yards) get the cleaner environment, with Skattebo's 8 targets and 60 receiving yards as the outlet when the blitz does arrive.

picks.why: Skattebo has 177 rush yards plus 60 receiving yards, 237 total over three games or about 79 a game, against a 53.5 rush+rec line. NO allows 5.14 YPC and 19 runs of 10+, and his 8 targets add a floor when NO's 35% blitz puts the NYG quarterback in a -0.19 EPA spot.

Nabers has 259 receiving yards on 33 targets over the last three, about 86 a game, versus a 73 line. NO allows 8.28 YPA to the left and 8.88 through the middle, and the NYG quarterback is +0.24 EPA when not blitzed against a defense that blitzes only 35%.
